turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. Meredith Kalinowski. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it.

Why does my son have a zero?

I didn't come in to be thanked. I came in because my son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class.

Who decided that, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?

We're not here about the weather, Hale.

I have a client call at 4:40. Why does Owen have a zero?
What do you do for fun?

I'm waiting, Hale.

My son has a zero in your gradebook and nobody called me first. Answer the question.
